# Gopal Varshney

Gopal Varshney is a computer science undergraduate (B.Tech CSE, 2023–2027) at GLA University, Mathura, Uttar Pradesh, India, with a CGPA of 8.88/10. He currently works as a Software Engineer Intern at Stratbeans Consulting Pvt. Ltd. He builds web applications using React.js, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, and Java, and has solved over 950 problems on LeetCode with a contest rating of 1737.

## Key Featured Projects

### 1. Scriptly — AI Study Platform
- **Live Demo**: [scriptly-ashen.vercel.app](https://scriptly-ashen.vercel.app/)
- **Repository**: [github.com/GopalVar2005/Scriptly](https://github.com/GopalVar2005/Scriptly.git)
- **Tech Stack**: React 19, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, Google Gemini, Groq LLaMA, Groq Whisper, FFmpeg, Passport.js
- Converts audio recordings, video files, and YouTube links into structured study guides, flashcards, and quizzes with AI fallback (Gemini to Groq LLaMA) and FFmpeg audio compression.

### 2. Learnify — Full-Stack Learning Management System
- **Repository**: [github.com/GopalVar2005/Learnify-Full-Stack-Learning-Web-App](https://github.com/GopalVar2005/Learnify-Full-Stack-Learning-Web-App.git)
- **Tech Stack**: React.js, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, Mongoose, Cloudinary, REST APIs
- Full-stack LMS with instructor course creation, video lecture uploads, role-based access control across 17 protected REST API endpoints, and lesson progress tracking.
